name: Contingency direct-hire desk: controls, automation & I&C engineers for Illinois manufacturers, integrators and engineering firms (post-review)
summary: POST-REVIEW MODEL. Stage E assumptions with the Stage F adversarial reviewer's corrected drivers applied. Corrected base (review §1/§4): conversation->agreement 22%, fill 15%, ramp 15 mo, sales cycle 5 mo, repeat revenue $520/mo (0.35 repeats/yr), churn 5.5%/mo; EV 1.5x (review §3). Optimistic = the Stage E base in every driver (review: 'The Stage E base becomes the optimistic case'), except EV 2.0x (also Stage E base). Conservative = Stage E conservative unchanged (review: 'Conservative (unchanged)'). Original Stage E model: WS12-014_assumptions.json (unchanged).
evidence_notes: STAGE F CORRECTIONS (07_review/WS12-014_review.md): lead_to_proposal_pct base 0.30->0.22; proposal_to_win_pct base 0.20->0.15; founder_ramp_months base 12->15; sales_cycle_months base 4->5; arpc_monthly (repeat revenue) base 670->520; monthly_churn_pct base 0.050->0.055; ev_multiple base 2.0->1.5 (opt 2.75->2.0); optimistic scenario := Stage E base (all drivers, staff, overhead); conservative unchanged (note: its conversion 25% and repeat revenue $570 sit above the corrected base; offset by 7 conversations/mo, 18-mo ramp, 7% churn, $13.7k fee)

Licensing: 225 ILCS 515/1.1 excludes persons in consulting or recruiting compensated solely by an employer, provided the individual is never charged a fee directly or indirectly (incl. resume preparation or any personal service) [A, E-WS12014-S001]; IDOL FAQ repeats this [A, E-WS12014-S002]. No IDOL licence or bond for an employer-paid desk.

Fee basis: 20% most common North American direct-hire fee (SIA 2021 via secondary) [D, C9-S025]; Top Echelon network 2018 engineering placements averaged 23% / $24.5k on $105.8k salary, industry & manufacturing 20% / $18.7k [D, E-WS12014-S018].

Salary: Illinois controls/I&C postings show pay ranges $72-156k; engineer-level midpoints cluster ~$95-140k (Ingredion, Medline, Abbott, Primient, Ameren, BW Design Group, Formic, Sargent & Lundy) [D, E-WS12014-S025, S027, S028]. Base salary $105k.
Realization: Kforce books direct hire net of a fallout reserve, fallout period typically <=90 days [A, E-WS12014-S012]; 85% realization (base) is E.

Cyclicality: Robert Half perm revenue -57% in 2009 [A, E-WS12014-S011]; -21.7% in 2023 (placements -24.1%, avg fee +2.4%) [A, E-WS12014-S009]; -9.8% in 2025 (placements -13.6%, avg fee +3.8%) [A, E-WS12014-S010]; +6.2% Q3 2026 [A, C9-S023]. US manufacturing job openings 1,025k (Apr 2022) -> 376k (Apr 2025) -> 584k (Sep 2026, P) [C, E-WS12014-S014].

Productivity benchmark: PageGroup GP per fee earner GBP148.9k in 2025 (~$195-200k), 72% permanent [B, E-WS12014-S013]; Top Echelon 2025 top-10 split-network recruiters 7-61 placements, $99k-$524k cash-in [D, E-WS12014-S019].

Access barriers: Chamberlain posting tells agencies not to contact hiring managers [D, E-WS12014-S026]; Abbott runs a separate Workday 'Agency' site [D, DG-S026]; MSP/VMS fees 1-4% of revenue and margin compression (Kforce) [A, E-WS12014-S012].
Tools: Recruit CRM $95-215/user/mo [B, DG-S040]; LinkedIn Recruiter Lite ~$170/mo, 30 InMails (third-party, D) [D, E-WS12014-S022]; Top Echelon $135-150/mo [B, DG-S043].

Long-term: SIA forecasts US staffing +2.4% 2026 and +2.2% 2027 [C, E-WS12014-S030]; sold service businesses SDE multiple median 2.38x (LQ 1.75x) [D, E-WS05007-S007]; owner-dependent perm desks assumed below the service median (E).

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: No IDOL licence/bond for employer-paid recruiters [A, C9-S022]; only entity, fee agreement and tools.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: STAGE F CORRECTION: 07_review/WS12-014_review.md §4: sales cycle 4 -> 5 months; optimistic = Stage E base 4 | Stage E source: Job order to start typically 30-90 days plus sourcing time; first fee ~4 months after first outreach (E); Paraform claims ~12-day fills on its marketplace [D, C9-S024].
drivers.founder_ramp_months__source: STAGE F CORRECTION: 07_review/WS12-014_review.md §4: ramp 12 -> 15 months (no agreed benchmark; in-firm ramps assume existing job orders [D]); optimistic = Stage E base 12 | Stage E source: Corrected in Stage E (was 6/9/12). In-firm benchmarks expect a new recruiter's first placement or near-miss by days 61-90 using the firm's existing job orders, and there is 'no universally agreed industry number' for full ramp [D, E-WS12014-S023]. A solo newcomer must build clients and candidates at once, so full pace is assumed at 12 months (base).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Hiring-manager conversations about a specific open controls/automation role per month; universe evidenced by public postings [D, DG-S020..S039; E-WS12014-S025..S028]. Optimistic cut from 10 to 9 in Stage E so per-producer revenue stays within public benchmarks [B, E-WS12014-S013; D, E-WS12014-S019].
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: STAGE F CORRECTION: 07_review/WS12-014_review.md §1 and §4 top-5 table: conversation -> signed agreement 30% -> 22% so that passing the playbook's own decisive gate (>=5 of 30 = 16.7%) is consistent with base; optimistic = Stage E base 30%; conservative unchanged (25%, offset by 7 conversations/month and an 18-month ramp) | Stage E source: Conversation -> signed fee agreement / job order; analyst estimate.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: STAGE F CORRECTION: 07_review/WS12-014_review.md §4: fill ratio 20% -> 15% (non-exclusive orders vs in-house TA with LinkedIn Hiring Assistant [B] and Actalent/Aerotek; PageGroup flags offer conversion as its top problem [B]); optimistic = Stage E base 20% | Stage E source: Contingency job order -> placement (fill ratio). Non-exclusive orders compete with in-house TA and other agencies; analyst estimate.
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Junior recruiter first-time-client placements; analyst estimate.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Placed engineers and hiring managers who change employers refer the desk; optimistic trimmed from 2.5 in Stage E (benchmark cap).
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: STAGE F CORRECTION: 07_review/WS12-014_review.md §4: churn 5% -> 5.5%/month; optimistic = Stage E base 5% | Stage E source: Non-exclusive relationships lapse after hiring needs end; 5%/month = ~20-month average active life; optimistic raised from 4% in Stage E (benchmark cap).
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: STAGE F CORRECTION: 07_review/WS12-014_review.md §4: repeat revenue $670 -> $520/month per active client (0.35 repeat placements/yr instead of 0.45; repeats consume desk time); optimistic = Stage E base $670 | Stage E source: Repeat placements per active client per year x realized fee / 12: cons 0.5 x $13,680; base 0.45 x $17,850; opt 0.42 x $22,770 (opt cut from $950 in Stage E so per-producer revenue stays <= ~$350k, near the top of public benchmarks).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Realized first fee: cons $95k x 18% x 0.80; base $105k x 20% x 0.85; opt $115k x 22% x 0.90. Salary D [E-WS12014-S025, S027, S028; DG-S034]; fee D [C9-S025; E-WS12014-S018]; realization E with A-level fallout mechanism [E-WS12014-S012].
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: RH average fee per placement rose 2.4% in 2023 and 3.8% in 2025 even as placements fell [A, E-WS12014-S009, S010]; 3% assumed.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: RH perm gross margin 99.8% [A, C9-S023]; 95% leaves room for per-search job ads, background checks, candidate travel.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: As above plus first-search job advertising; split-network deals (50/50) would lower this sharply.
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Bad debt / fee disputes / payment processing.
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Plant visits, lunches, extra InMail/credits per new client.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Sponsored job ads budget; analyst estimate (Indeed/ZipRecruiter price pages blocked).
drivers.dso_days__source: Invoice on start, net-30 [D, C9-S024]; Kforce recognises direct hire when the candidate has accepted, resigned and starts within the following month [A, E-WS12014-S012]; mid-size manufacturers often pay late (E).
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Stage E standardization rule re-applied to the post-review base: smallest round injection keeping base cash >= 0 (REV base peak funding rounded up to $100). Does not change operating profit, FCF or peak funding.
drivers.rep_ramp_months__source: Hired recruiter works the founder's existing job orders, so first placement in ~90 days and meaningful production by month 6 (base) [D, E-WS12014-S023]; conservative 9.
drivers.lt_growth_y6_pct__source: Mature desk grows by fee inflation (~3%/yr, RH avg fee +2.4% to +3.8% [A, E-WS12014-S009, S010]) plus occasional recruiter adds; SIA forecasts US staffing +2.4% 2026, +2.2% 2027 [C, E-WS12014-S030]. Conservative 1% reflects a cyclical trough year.
drivers.lt_growth_decay__source: Growth fades as the founder's niche saturates; no cross-cycle evidence for small desks.
drivers.incremental_roic_pct__source: Growth capital = recruiter ramp losses (6-9 months of ~$6.9k/mo before production) plus wash-outs. At scale, recruiter pay absorbs most gross profit: PageGroup EBIT/GP 2.7% in 2025 (Americas 3.2%) [B, E-WS12014-S013]; RH perm segment margin 2.9% (2025) vs 17.6% (2022) [A, E-WS12014-S010, S009].
drivers.maint_capex_pct_op__source: Asset-light: laptops, headsets, website refresh; software is opex.
drivers.reserve_months__source: Perm placement is the most cyclical staffing line: RH perm -57% in 2009 [A, E-WS12014-S011], -21.7% in 2023 [A, E-WS12014-S009]; reserve raised above the 2-month default.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: STAGE F CORRECTION: 07_review/WS12-014_review.md §3: 'Valuation 2.0x ... arguably generous for a single-producer desk where relationships leave with the producer. 1.0-1.5x is more defensible' -> base 1.5x (top of reviewer range), conservative 1.0x (unchanged), optimistic 2.0x (= Stage E base) | Stage E source: Sold service businesses SDE multiple LQ 1.75x / median 2.38x / UQ 3.13x [D, E-WS05007-S007]; an owner-dependent perm desk transfers poorly (relationships leave with the producer, G7) so base is set below the service median and conservative at 1.0x.
drivers.tax_rate_pct__source: Stage E standardization (30% blended pass-through estimate).
drivers.founder_draw_per_month__source: Stage E standardization: $4,000/month from month 13 in all scenarios.

staff.notes: Hired when monthly revenue first exceeds $20k. ~$50k base + commission on own billings + payroll taxes/paid leave (~$6.5k) + tool seats (~$400: CRM, Recruiter Lite, data). E.

staff.notes: Experienced hire who can run the desk day-to-day. E.

overhead.notes: ~$170/mo, 30 InMails/mo, overage ~$10 each (third-party pages; LinkedIn does not publish) [D, E-WS12014-S022]; conservative adds InMail overage.
B, DG-S043; used only in conservative case
